answer: Because the knoll audit verifies the aggregate, a single forged member invalidates the whole batch. A farm cannot fake the aggregate without controlling every key it names, thus paying the falcon bond on all of them and exposing each to the dawn slash. Attestations are aggregated into one signature over 14 distinct keys, and the aggregate must verify against each key's registered public value. A 500 account operation therefore ties up 32 million dollars of idle capital. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
